sources.organization: Department of Census and Statistics, Sri Lanka
sources.title: Administrative Division Codes (GND List / MRCB-2024)
sources.purpose: Administrative codes, English names, and Province → District → DS → GN hierarchy
sources.notes: Sheet GNDList. Source footnote: Master Registry of Census Blocks (MRCB-2024), Cartography Division. As at 19th March 2024. English names only; no Sinhala or Tamil columns.

sources.organization: Department of Census and Statistics, Sri Lanka
sources.title: No. of GN Divisions by DS Division and District
sources.purpose: Official DS and GN count cross-checks by district
sources.notes: Sheets: 'No. of GNDs by DSD & District' and 'No. of GNDs & DSDs by District'. As at 19th March 2024. English labels only.

sources.organization: Ministry of Home Affairs, Sri Lanka — Home Affairs Division (IT Unit)
sources.title: LIFe Location Codes (Grama Niladhari Division List)
sources.acquisitionMechanism: Official generated HTML GN report (POST /lifecode/views/rpt_gn_list.php) per district; cascade IDs from POST /lifecode/views/fetch.php
sources.purpose: Authoritative Sinhala/Tamil administrative names for DCS codes joinable via LIFe → GND_UID (national validation incomplete for recoded DS/GN units)
sources.notes: No published source date on the LIFe UI or GN reports. Raw HTML is gitignored. Reproduce with: dotnet run --project tools/LankaLens.DataBuilder -- acquire-moha. DataBuilder validate/build never fetch live MOHA.

sources.organization: National Spatial Data Infrastructure (NSDI), Sri Lanka
sources.title: Boundaries — Grama Niladhari Division polygon layer
sources.acquisitionMechanism: Official ArcGIS REST query (GET /query?f=geojson) paginated by resultOffset at maxRecordCount 1000
sources.purpose: Grama Niladhari polygon geometry for derived coordinates, joinable to DCS codes via the admin_code attribute
sources.notes: admin_code carries the DCS GND_UID layout (province+district+DS+GN); gnd_census_code is null throughout and is not used. Polygons are year_created 2017, satellite-traced, so derived coordinates are approximate and are not survey-grade. Redistribution terms are not stated on the layer page — coordinates are emitted to data/generated only and are not bundled into the NuGet package. Raw GeoJSON is gitignored. Reproduce with: dotnet run --project tools/LankaLens.DataBuilder -- acquire-geo. DataBuilder build-geo never fetches live NSDI.
